decisions.statement: The property definitions a page type declares are asked of `@akasha/page-service`.
An empty list is never answered for a page type that is there.
A page type nothing has is answered as null rather than as an empty list.
A shape answered once is held for every later question.
A shape refused is asked for again.
A shape has the property naming the account a page belongs to.
A definition's type is how a value is rendered rather than the page type declaring that property.
Every property page type is named here beside the type a screen draws.
A property page type named nowhere here is rendered as text.
No type a screen has no drawing for leaves here.

definition: the property definitions a file-backed page type declares
